carla (acme): Hi, we're seeing repeated failures when using JSON mode. The model returns invalid JSON ~30% of the time and our parser throws. Example body returned:

```
{"items": [{"id": 1, "name": "foo"}, {"id": 2, "name": "bar",}]}
```

This causes a hard exception in our ingestion pipeline. We send the request with the schema attached and temperature=0. Repro steps below.

alice (support): Thanks for the report — sorry about the disruption. Can you paste the exact request payload and the endpoint you hit? Also which Redwood model + mode (json_mode / structured_output) are you using?

carla (acme): We call POST /v1/generate with body: `{"model":"redwood-1.3","mode":"json","schema":{...},"prompt":"generate items list"}`. We supply the JSON schema; sometimes the model returns plaintext, sometimes broken JSON with trailing commas or missing braces. We observed this across ~25 requests this morning.

alice (support): Got it. I've collected the failing response you pasted. I'm escalating to eng-ml. For now, two quick workarounds you can try: 1) set stop sequences to ensure the model finishes cleanly, 2) post-validate and retry up to 2x with a request that clarifies "Output MUST be valid JSON only".

ben (eng-ml): Looking. This looks like two potential causes: streaming chunk boundaries producing truncated objects, and occasional schema confusion when the prompt isn't explicit enough. Can you confirm if you used streaming=true?

carla (acme): We were streaming to decrease latency. Turning off streaming reduced errors in a short test.

ben (eng-ml): That matches a known edge-case where streaming + strict json mode can produce partial chunks that the client may try to parse prematurely. Short-term mitigation: set streaming=false OR buffer the stream until you detect a full top-level object (e.g., matching braces). Also: temperature=0 and adding an explicit wrapper like `{"result": <JSON>}` often reduces schema drift. We'll push a fix but need logs to reproduce reliably.

alice (support): @ben, can you triage and mark this P2? Customer-facing SLA says respond within 24h for P2 escalations. I'll draft a reply to Carla with the workarounds.

ben (eng-ml): Will take it. Repro steps I need: 1) sample request (you provided), 2) exact response bytes (including streaming chunks), 3) SDK/version or curl command. If possible, paste the raw bytes including newline/CR.

carla (acme): Pasted a minimal curl we used: 

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3","mode":"json","stream":true,"prompt":"generate items list","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"name":{"type":"string"}}}}}}'
```

The raw stream we captured had fragments like: `...{"id":2,"name":"bar",}\n` which breaks JSON.parse.

dmitri (sre): From infra side: we can add a gateway-level sanitizer that rejects obviously invalid top-level JSON from model responses and return a structured error to clients instead of forwarding broken payloads. That would avoid ingestion crashes on customer side while we fix the generator.

alice (support): For customer comms I'll send: 1) acknowledgement + P2 escalation, 2) immediate mitigation steps (turn off streaming, set temperature=0, add wrapper + stop tokens, implement client-side buffered parsing), 3) ETA: eng to investigate within 24h and follow up with root cause and timeline. OK? :thumbsup:

carla (acme): That sounds fine. Please include a short script we can drop in to auto-retry when parse fails.

ben (eng-ml): Suggested retry snippet (pseudo):

```
function safeParseAndRetry(raw, retries=2){
  try{ return JSON.parse(raw); }
  catch(e){
    if(retries<=0) throw e;
    // attempt quick cleanups
    const cleaned = raw.replace(/,\s*}\s*]/g, '} ]').replace(/,\s*}/g,'}').trim();
    return safeParseAndRetry(cleaned, retries-1);
  }
}
```

ben (eng-ml): I'll instrument tests to replicate streaming boundary truncation and add a fix to the streaming assembler. Will keep you posted.

alice (support): I'll send the workaround + snippet to the customer now and queue the logs for eng. Carla, we'll follow up within 24h with updates.

carla (acme): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-7893 - json-mode invalid responses. Assigned to eng-ml.

ben (eng-ml): Marking this thread for follow-up. Action items: collect raw stream logs from Carla, add regression test, implement streaming assembler fix, consider gateway sanitizer, and add docs note about streaming+json-mode.

alice (support): Closing loop: emailed Carla with temporary fixes and retry snippet. Will reopen if customer reports more failures.
